insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Co. Ltd.

room_rent.note: Pro-rata deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room taken

icu.note: Pro-rata clause applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye/year; listed modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.) capped at 50% SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability norms

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for most listed conditions (cataract, hernia, etc.); 36 months for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; 24-hour hospitalisation limit not applicable

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; fixed cap of ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, masks, and many consumables explicitly listed as non-payable in Annexure-A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment must be taken within India only (Section 10.7 and 7.19)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; portability/migration credits count

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/non-monthly modes; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability with credit transfer for waiting periods, CB and moratorium

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, sterility/IVF, global treatment, refractive error <7.5D, consumables, adventure sports (professional)
